description:
Build & own a business inside GoStudent

 

About GoStudent Builders

We bring the customers. You build the company.

With GoStudent Builders, we're turning validated business opportunities into independent, revenue-generating businesses. We provide the infrastructure, customer access, technology and operational support. You build and run the business.

We currently have 14 validated opportunities across several markets.

Learn more: https://www.gostudent.org/en-gb/builders/

The opportunity

We are looking for AI-native builders who want to build and operate a business from the ground up — not simply manage an existing team or project.

You can apply as an individual or as a team of 1–3 people. You will take ownership of one specific business opportunity, validate it, launch it and grow it into a profitable company.

The business challenge for this market

1. Maturità and medical school entrance prep
2. YKS and LGS prep beyond Istanbul
3. Holiday camps at scale
4. A creator network for performance marketing
5. AI agent for lead follow-up and win-back

What you'll do

  • Take ownership of one of the identified business opportunities.

  • Build and launch a revenue-generating business from scratch.

  • Use AI tools, automation and GoStudent's infrastructure to move fast.

  • Validate customer demand, develop the offering and acquire customers.

  • Own the commercial performance, operations and growth of your business.

  • Continuously improve the business based on customer feedback and data.

What we're are looking for

  • You are an entrepreneurial builder who enjoys turning ideas into real businesses.

  • You are AI-native and use AI tools to build, automate and execute faster.

  • You are hands-on: you build, test, launch and iterate yourself.

  • You have strong ownership and are comfortable operating independently.

  • You are commercially minded and focused on generating revenue.

  • You are fluent in English; some opportunities may require the local language.

  • Previous experience in education is not required.

What GoStudents provides

  • Access to more than 200,000 customers and an established network of 850+ locations.

  • Existing infrastructure, licenses, sales capabilities and operational support.

  • Access to BrutalOS, GoStudent's AI agent platform.

  • The opportunity to build on an established platform rather than starting entirely from zero.

The business model

This is an entrepreneurial ownership opportunity, not a traditional salaried position.

 

  • You own 75% of the business; GoStudent owns 25%.

  • There is no fixed salary. Your income comes from the earnings and profits of the business.

  • GoStudent charges a fee on revenue routed through its channels.

  • From year three, GoStudent may acquire a majority stake at a pre-agreed fixed EBITDA multiple, paid in GoStudent shares.

Location and setup

  • Location: Italy & Turkey, remote

  • Working model: remote

  • Team size: Individual applicants or teams of 1–3

  • Working language: English, with local language requirements depending on the business opportunity

  • Start date: January 2027

How to apply?

To apply, please include the following in your application:

 

  • What you've built: In five lines, tell us what you've built and why you're the right person or team for this opportunity.

  • Your drive and resilience: Explain what motivates you and why you have the grit to push through challenges when things get difficult.

  • Your chosen challenge: Tell us in the next step which of the listed business challenges you want to take ownership of — or pitch your own idea.

  • Something you've built: Share one project you're proud of, including a link to the product, repository or project.

 

Ready to build something of your own? Apply now and turn your ambition into a business you own.
